description: Keyword search of ONE model, the museums, by name, with two filters no other search tool has: city and country. Use it when you are looking for a museum or for the museums of a place; when the words may name something else than a museum, use search_fts. Returns only good-confidence matches with pk, name, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large museum image, null when there is none), city, country and relevance score.

city.description: Optional city to narrow the search.

country.description: Optional country to narrow the search.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Museum name or words from it.

name: search_museums
title: Search museums
